missing_evidence: Redis server metrics/logs showing latency or saturation during the incident window
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (DependencyUnavailable: redis operation failed), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order calls to hit ReadTimeout, which surfaces as 502 on gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs are present; the timeout is inferred from gateway-side spans only.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503 and order ReadTimeout, yielding 502 on /v1/checkout with ~2s durations. Gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout and p95 ~2387ms. Deployment record only confirms gateway v1.0.0 and does not establish causation.
